name: Coronea Bishop
original_name: コロネア・ビショップ
source:
Former maid of Killing family and Scarlett herself. Loves Scarlett as family member and even obsessive with her. She calls Scarlett "Lady". Tougou calls her "Slit-Eyed Baroness".

[spoiler]Quited being a maid of Killing family after it disinherited Scarlett. After the Incident with Warp Gates Scarlett was found in the Zorph Muffet's space sector, and Coronea was his maid. Lied her about Tougou to keep her to herself.[/spoiler]

"I won't give the Lady away to anyone anymore... Nor to the Killing family, nor to that man."
